Read the actual Definition: under a measurable parameter model, worst-case risk is a supremum and minimax value is its infimum over randomized rules; no minimizer is asserted. The finite model kernels in the two-point, cube, and Fano claims meet these hypotheses.

Read the actual Definition: each parameter section of the loss is measurable and risk is the extended nonnegative iterated integral against the action kernel and P_theta; no parameter measurability is needed for pointwise risk. The lower bounds use squared loss.
